definition: [ עָשַׂר ] verb denominative take the tenth of, tithe ; — Qal Imperfect 3 masculine singular יַעְשׂר 1Sam 8:15 ; 1Sam 8:17 (with accusative of thing tithed). Pi`el Imperfect + Infinitive absolute give a tenth of , with accusative of thing: 2 masculine singular עַשֵּׂר תְּעַשֵּׂר Deut 14:22 1 singular עַשֵּׂר אֲעַשְּׂרֶנּוּ לָ֑ח Gen 28:22 ( P ); Participle taking the tenth , הַמְעַשְּׂרִים Neh 10:38 . Hiph`il (so usually explained) Infinitive לַעְשֵׂר Deut 26:12 with accusative of congnate meaning with verb i.e. taking, reckoning, tithe , but Infinitive construct with ֵ֯ improbable, < read לְעַשֵּׂר Pi`el ; בַּעְשֵׂר Neh 10:39 absolute, i.e. receiving tithes , but read probably בַּעְשׂר Qal (on anomalous points, see Ges «GKC:53k»§ 53k Dr Deut 26:12 ).
